selectionPolicy: latest-two-full-recoverable-snapshot-manifest-createdAt; successful or terminal-rollback deployments both eligible
selectionEvidenceLimit: Manifest bytes/receipt bindings and all manifest-listed regular file types/sizes only; no payload SHA256 rehash and no new SQLite probes/backups
preservation: Old snapshot manifest.json and capture root activation/failed/rollback/node-before/previous-release evidence remain at their original paths; deletion targets are only exact payload/data/check directories
No production data, current release, project originals or SSH credentials are targets
capture-standby-voice and other unclassified control materials are retained pending a separate role/scope check
executionRequirements: Acquire the existing root-owned capture-activate.lock nonblocking before any mutation; if busy stop/defer
Re-read current symlink and retained manifest/activation hashes; recompute latest-two selection if a newer complete snapshot appeared
Verify exactly two retained snapshot contents/SQLite recovery with the pinned current recovery helper under an explicit bounded root execution; this planner did not run it
Recheck every exact allowlist directory identity (ns strings), realpath, same device, mounts and live cwd/exe/fd/maps/argv references immediately before deletion
Do not follow internal symlinks; remove only exact allowlisted directory trees with a symlink-safe fd-based remover
Keep small historical manifests/activation/node-before/previous-release/doc evidence and publish actual per-item deletion/after-free results; do not create a new backup
